card.name: Monitoring schedule wording before frequency
card.fires_on: Linking words or word parts inside lab-monitoring schedules, just before the interval is stated, such as 'and', 'then', 'once', 'at least' or 'periodically' after 'every 3 months'.

modes.label: Linking word in a schedule
modes.description: Words like 'and' or 'then' that follow one interval and lead into the next one.
modes.example: every 3 months during the first year of treatment,<< and>> annually thereafter

modes.label: Inside 'periodically'
modes.description: The middle of the word 'periodically' in monitoring instructions.

modes.label: Quantity word before an interval
modes.description: Words like 'once' or 'at least' that come right before an interval such as 'weekly' or 'every 3 months'.
modes.example: then<< once>> every 3 months or as clinically indicated

card.writes: It suppresses the word 'frequency' and its translations, so it favors a specific interval over a general statement about how often.
card.plain: It marks the point in a lab-monitoring schedule where the next time interval is about to be given.
